info.title: ThreatMAMBA
info.description: Frontend handoff snapshot, 7 November 2026. Browser clients use /api/investigations. Authentication verification is supplied by an external identity provider; there is no login/token issuer. Explicit local development mode uses no Authorization header. See FRONTEND_API_REFERENCE.md.

AnalyzeRequest.title: AnalyzeRequest
AnalyzeRequest.description: Raw text, which the hub splits, or sentences already split (e.g. a D2 report), which are used unchanged.

IOC.title: IOC
IOC.description:
One indicator of compromise.

sentence_indices are the hub's sentence numbers: every sentence the indicator appears in, sorted. It is empty
for an indicator found by an online lookup rather than in the text. context and source are the extractor's
own; for IOC-hunter, context is the sentences of its own splitter where it found the indicator.

IOCType.title: IOCType

TTPHit.title: TTPHit
TTPHit.description: One ATT&CK label found in one sentence: a technique (T1566) or a tactic (TA0001), never a sub-technique.

servers.description: Hub development server; change to your deployment
